standard_prerequisites: quasi-compact algebraic spaces admit surjective etale maps from affine schemes (Properties of Spaces, Lemma spaces-properties-lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover)
m-pseudo-coherence is insensitive to replacing the space by an etale cover (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-pseudo-coherent-independent-representative)
coherence of sheaves is etale local on Noetherian spaces (Cohomology of Spaces, Lemma spaces-cohomology-lemma-coherent-Noetherian)
the comparison of D_QCoh on the small etale site with the Zariski site of a scheme via epsilon, with E = epsilon^*E_0 (lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site of the same chapter)
descent of m-pseudo-coherence, of finite type, and the flatness of epsilon (lemma-descend-pseudo-coherent, lemma-descend-finite-type and lemma-epsilon-flat of the same chapter)

the scheme case: on a Noetherian scheme, m-pseudo-coherence is equivalent to coherence of H^i for i >= m and vanishing for i >> 0 (Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma perfect-lemma-identify-pseudo-coherent-noetherian)
core_obligations: Prove that for a Noetherian algebraic space X and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the conditions (1) H^i(E) coherent for i >= m and zero for i >> 0 and (2) E is m-pseudo-coherent are equivalent; in particular E is pseudo-coherent if and only if E is in D^-_Coh(O_X)
proof_roadmap: Choose a surjective etale map U -> X from an affine Noetherian scheme; m-pseudo-coherence and coherence of the H^i are both etale local, so both conditions may be checked after restriction to U, reducing to the representable case.

For X a scheme, write E = epsilon^*E_0 with E_0 in D_QCoh(O_{X0}); m-pseudo-coherence descends along epsilon by lemma-descend-pseudo-coherent, finite type (coherence) of the H^i descends by lemma-descend-finite-type, and vanishing of the H^i descends by the flatness of lemma-epsilon-flat.
All three reductions together identify both sides on X with the corresponding conditions on E_0, so the claim reduces to the scheme case in Derived Categories of Schemes.
difficulty_reason: H3: an etale-localization reduction followed by a comparison along the site morphism epsilon, with each invariance step quoted from a named lemma.
